inputKind: paste then navigate (autosave lifecycle; no editor paste involved - onUpdate -> structuredContentFromDocument -> onChange -> scheduleAutosave)
harness: code-read + existing hook tests (useQuestionAutosave.offline/durability); mocked save gateway

lifecycle.onUpdate: RichQuestionComposer onUpdate fires per TipTap transaction -> structuredContentFromDocument(doc) (always v2 + withRichContentIdentities) -> onChange
lifecycle.schedule: AuthoringWorkspace handleChange sets draft + autosave.scheduleAutosave(next); debounce 800ms default (useQuestionAutosave->useDurableLatestAutosave)
lifecycle.flush: flushNow/commitAndAdvance flush latest revision; returns {ok, isLatest}
lifecycle.offline: schedule while navigator.onLine=false keeps edits local (durable draft) and reports offline; online event reschedules newest draft; save NOT called while offline
lifecycle.conflict: 409/412/CONFLICT/VERSION_COLLISION/CONTROL_EPOCH_STALE or /revision|stale|conflict|changed elsewhere|changed while/ message -> conflict status; local wording stays durable, never auto-retried/dropped
lifecycle.durableLocal: saveDurableDraft(durableKey, revision) before/with server save; recover via onRecover without auto-overwriting newer server revision; commitAndAdvance resolves only after save settles
lifecycle.flushBeforeNavigation: AuthoringWorkspace flushBeforeNavigation: if status!=saved, flushNow(draft); navigation blocked with message on !ok (conflict/offline/generic variants); beforeunload warn guard while hasPendingChanges && (offline|unsaved|saving|error)

validatorOutcome: autosave is content-agnostic; SAT validation runs separately and remains the release gate
